name: scenario_linear_phasing
derivation: Full scenario through build_cashflow: 5 periods (0..4). Construction 2,000,000 agorot
phased linearly over periods 0-1 => 1,000,000 per period. Revenue 3,000,000 agorot phased
linearly over periods 3-4 => 1,500,000 per period. Both splits are exact (no remainder).
Profit = revenue - costs = 1,000,000 agorot (same as zero-rate NPV, by definition).
Simple payback: cumulative -1M, -2M, -2M, -0.5M, +1M; recovery inside period 4:
IRR is deliberately NOT pinned here: no closed form exists for this shape; the
NPV(IRR) ~ 0 property test covers it (ADR-0006 — never pin a value no human derived).
